 Jalen Green plays well in win Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Suns Correspondent | Tue, Nov 17th 2026, 8:28am EST 
 Jalen Green scored 16 points (5-10 FG, 2-4 3PT, 4-6 FT) to go with five rebounds and three steals in Monday night's 117-105 win over the Denver Nuggets. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Green has struggled a decent amount over the first chunk of the season, but that wasn't the case on Monday night. He was able to score 16 points on good shooting splits and also contributed very well on the defensive side of the ball with three steals. He will still have inconsistencies moving forward, but fantasy managers should be pleased with his performance in the meantime.
